provenance: label_a and label_b come from two independent automated annotators, final and note from an automated adjudicator that resolved every disagreement. All labels are pending review by the team.
sampling_rule: An error is a lexicon-ambiguous token (two or more length patterns for its skeleton in the system's own lexicon) of the soliloquies and tauber_beowulf test sets, pooled, whose predicted length pattern differs from gold. john_ws is not used. For each system, 200 errors were drawn with random.Random(1).sample. encoder_sentence: ByT5 sentence arm, seed 1, --max-bytes 2560, lr 3e-4, 5 epochs, zupitza_grammar left out of training (the selected configuration), lexicon = the other four training works plus WikiPron, pool 917 errors (468 prose, 449 verse). charsiug2p: CharsiuG2P IPA mapped to a length pattern, lexicon = all five training works plus WikiPron as in charsiu_g2p.analyse, pool 2,625 errors (1,607 prose, 1,018 verse). Ten tokens appear in both samples and were typed separately.
